apps.name: Virtual Wardrobe
apps.subtitle: Private virtual try-on wardrobe
apps.localizedDescription: Build a personalized 3D avatar from a guided 360° body scan and try on digital clothing. Privacy-first: adults-only consent, private storage, no face recognition, one-tap delete.
apps.versionDescription: Fixes the Wardrobe filter chips drawing over the grid, unreadable garment placeholders, and the Add button colliding with the tab bar.

versions.localizedDescription:
🔧 Virtual Wardrobe 3.0.1 — Wardrobe layout fixes

Fixes reported from a real device:

• The category filter chips were drawing on top of the garment grid, covering the labels under the first row. They now stay in their own row.

• Garments showed as flat coloured blocks. The catalog has no photos yet, so each tile falls back to a category symbol — that symbol is now large enough to read, and the icons are right: outerwear was showing a wind/breeze glyph and bottoms a walking figure.

• The floating Add Garment button collided with the tab bar and covered the last row of clothes. Add now lives in the top-right of the navigation bar.

🛠️ Virtual Wardrobe 3.0 — a bug-hunt release

🔒 SECURITY
Fixed a flaw where an outfit could be created referencing another account's avatar. The server now verifies you own anything you point at.

🔄 NO MORE GETTING STUCK
Avatar processing used to retry forever if the server became unreachable — on a screen with no back button. It now gives up cleanly and tells you what happened. Leaving that screen also used to leave a loop running in the background hammering the server; it stops properly now.

💾 SAVES THAT TELL THE TRUTH
Saving an outfit reported "saved" even when it failed. It now says when it didn't work. Double-tapping Save no longer creates two copies of the same outfit.

📶 STAYS SIGNED IN
A brief connection drop signed you out and threw you back to the login screen. Only a genuinely expired session does that now.

💬 BETTER ERRORS
Raw server messages no longer leak into the app; you get plain language instead.

The avatar is still a stylized, measurement-based preview.

🎨 Virtual Wardrobe 2.5 — light mode, and it remembers

☀️ LIGHT MODE
The app was locked to dark. Every screen now follows your system appearance, using Apple's semantic colours — so it also respects Increased Contrast and your accent tint. The camera capture flow stays dark on purpose.

⚡ FASTER, AND IT WORKS OFFLINE
Garment images are cached, so scrolling your wardrobe no longer re-downloads the same pictures — and garments you've already seen still show up with no connection.

📋 DUPLICATE AN OUTFIT
Swipe or long-press any saved outfit to copy it. The copy is independent, so you can change it without touching the original.

🔧 FIXES
Saved Outfits showed "No saved outfits yet" when the network failed, and a delete that failed silently came back on refresh — both now say what happened and let you retry. Onboarding gained a Skip button, and icons that previously ignored your text size now scale with it.

The avatar is still a stylized, measurement-based preview.

✨ Virtual Wardrobe 2.0 — redesigned

🪟 LIQUID GLASS
Floating controls and filters now use Apple's Liquid Glass on iOS 26, with a designed material fallback on iOS 17–18. Nothing is glass just for the sake of it — your garments stay the focus.

👕 A NEW WARDROBE
Image-first grid, native search, one-tap category filters, and long-press actions. Your clothes are the interface now.

♿ BUILT FOR EVERYONE
Full Dynamic Type (the grid becomes a single column at accessibility sizes), richer VoiceOver descriptions, Reduce Transparency and Reduce Motion support, and status that never relies on colour alone.

🎛️ CONSISTENT BY DESIGN
A real design system underpins spacing, type, shape, and motion — so every screen from here on matches.

This release is interface-focused; the avatar is still a stylized, measurement-based preview.

☁️ Virtual Wardrobe 1.4 — sync & shop

🔄 CROSS-DEVICE SYNC
Your units (cm/in), avatar skin tone & body build, and favourite outfits now sync to your account — sign in on another device and they follow you.

🛍️ SHOP GOT REAL
The shop now shows real prices and Buy links.

🧍 SERVER-GENERATED 3D BODY
Behind the scenes your avatar is now a real 3D mesh generated on the server (loadable by any glTF/AR viewer), and scans process in the background.

Still a stylized, measurement-based preview — full body reconstruction and cloth simulation are the road ahead.

🪞 Virtual Wardrobe 1.3 — try it on you

✨ AR MAGIC MIRROR (beta)
See garments overlaid on your own body, live in the camera, with ARKit body tracking.

🧵 FABRIC TEXTURES + BETTER CLOTHES
Denim, stripes, plaid and knit patterns, plus sleeves — clothes look like fabric now, not flat colour.

📷 REAL PROPORTIONS FROM A PHOTO
Measure from a single full-body photo using on-device Vision body-pose + your height.

🛍️ SHOP
Browse the catalog with prices, your recommended size, and Buy links.

⭐ FAVORITES
Star your best outfits; favourites sort to the top.

🎞️ EXPORT A SPIN VIDEO
Render and share a spinning clip of your dressed avatar.

Still a stylized, measurement-based preview — full body reconstruction and cloth simulation are the road ahead.

🚀 Virtual Wardrobe 1.2 — your realest avatar yet

📐 AR BODY MEASURE (beta)
On supported iPhones, point the camera at yourself and capture REAL measurements — height, shoulders, arm & leg length — straight from ARKit body tracking.

🧍 A MORE LIFELIKE AVATAR
Smoother body, hair, and skin tones. New Customize screen to pick your skin tone and body build.

🖼️ SCAN FROM PHOTOS
No room to spin? Import full-body photos from your library instead of a live scan.

📏 SIZE RECOMMENDATIONS
Pick a garment and see your suggested size and fit (snug / true to size / relaxed).

➕ ADD YOUR OWN CLOTHES
Create a garment by type and colour and try it on in 3D.

🆚 COMPARE OUTFITS
View two saved looks side-by-side on your avatar.

Note: circumferences (chest/waist/hip) are still estimated — full body reconstruction and cloth simulation are still ahead.

🎬 Virtual Wardrobe 1.1 — more of everything

🔄 ROTATE & POSE YOUR AVATAR
New Front / Side / Back camera presets in the 3D try-on, and share a snapshot of your look.

🧥 FILTER THE CLOSET
Browse clothes by category — Tops, Dresses, Bottoms, Outerwear, Shoes.

💾 MANAGE YOUR OUTFITS
A new Saved Outfits screen — reopen any look in 3D or swipe to delete.

⚙️ A REAL SETTINGS HUB
Units (cm / inches), server, data & privacy controls, how-scanning-works, and about — all in one place.

👋 GUIDED ONBOARDING
A quick walkthrough the first time you open the app.

Plus polish throughout. Still a measurement-based 3D preview — LiDAR body scanning and true cloth simulation are next.

✨ Virtual Wardrobe 1.0 — the first full release

👗 TRY ON CLOTHES IN 3D
A real, rotatable 3D avatar built from your body measurements. Drag to spin, pinch to zoom. Tap garments to dress it and watch outfits layer on live.

📸 FASTER, SMOOTHER SCANNING
The 360° body scan now compresses and uploads frames in parallel — noticeably quicker. Front camera by default with a one-tap flip.

📏 EDIT YOUR MEASUREMENTS
Fine-tune height, chest, waist, hip and inseam — your 3D avatar updates to match.

💾 SAVE & COMPARE OUTFITS
Build looks and save them to your wardrobe, synced to your account.

🔒 PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Adults-only consent, private storage, no face recognition, one-tap delete.

Note: the avatar is a measurement-based 3D preview — realistic body scanning (LiDAR / photogrammetry) and true cloth simulation are coming next.

What's new in 0.1.2:
• Camera now defaults to the front (selfie) camera so you can see yourself
• Tap the Front/Back button to switch cameras for other framing

What's new in 0.1.1:
• 360° multi-frame body capture (replaces the 4-photo flow) with a live progress ring — turn slowly and it grabs ~24 frames
• Connects to the live backend by default (wardrobe-api.losthosting.com) — no server setup needed
• New app icon
• Backend now accepts many frames per scan
